Marcus/Karthik —

Draft discount table for planning (suggested bands, final subject to volume confirmation):

- 1-year prepaid: 8% term discount off list (standard)
- 2-year prepaid: 14% term discount, with a 6% front-loaded first-year ramp credit if Q1 commitments > 40% of annual commitment
- 3-year prepaid: 20% term discount, plus flexible ramp credits in year one (cumulative up to 10%)

Notes:
- For phased ramp proposals we recommend front-loading crediting tied to minimum quarterly purchases rather than pure $ refunds — reduces billing complexity for finance on both sides.
- If Clarion expects bursty usage, we should propose a 15% buffer band for autoscaling (overage billed at committed rate + 30%).

Karthik — can you confirm we can reserve the requested pool in us-west and if any region pricing differentials apply? If we need to offer a cheaper EU region fallback note that now.
